programme.title: E1 - The Fickle River
programme.desc: Travel to Samburu, where matriarch Anastasia turns her elephant herd north after a local river dries up. Then, in Naboisho, see cheetah mom Kuleta evade a crafty pack of hyenas. Later, in Laikipia, check in on wild dog Phoenix and her new litter.

programme.title: E1 - Animal Allure
programme.desc: The drive to reproduce is one of nature’s most primal forces. And with over a hundred thousand animal species in Africa, countless strategies have evolved. Discover how the residents of Zambia’s Luangwa Valley strive to pass on their genes.

programme.title: E2 - Life's Lessons
programme.desc: If young animals survive until adulthood, the chances for survival are greatly increased - but many challenges face them before they can strike out on their own. Some have months to grow-up; other have decades – but all, have lots to learn along the way. From getting to grips with their bodies and learning to feed themselves, to practicing fighting skills and learning how to form friendships. There are many hurdles along the way, but every small success could mean the difference between life and death.

programme.title: E3 - Life's Legacies
programme.desc: For every species on earth the right to mate is the purpose of life. Passing on your genes to the next generation is every animal’s legacy. But it’s not easy, it can be a struggle to find a mate and then a fight to gain access. Only the strongest and most determined will win at Luangwa’s mating game.

programme.title: E41
programme.desc: In Onjeong Market, located in Onjeong, a town some distance away from Seoul, the area is buzzing with change as apartment complexes are built and plans for subway extensions and new town developments are announced. Across a single street stand a principled general hospital, Gongmyeongjeongdae Clinic, and traditional Korean clinic, Yangji Barun Clinic. The two families who run these places have been bitter enemies for years, bound by a long standing grudge from an incident in the past. Even the smallest matters turn into big fights, making them the most famous rival families in Onjeong. This is a family growth drama about these two families as they unravel their long held misunderstandings, heal their wounds, learn to love one another, and are reborn as one family.

programme.title: E2 - Let's Sing Our Favorite Classic Songs!
programme.desc: Come sing your favorite classic songs with Kii & Yii! The sing-along starts on Old MacDonald's farm, where the friends learn how to spell the friendly dog's name in the song 'Bingo'! Then, listen as Mr. Cat sings a story about his grand adventure visiting the Queen in her palace. The fun continues with the story of the Lion & the Unicorn, the flying adventure of 'Two Little Dicky Birds' & a song about the Old Woman Who Lived in a Shoe.

programme.title: E3 - Wonders Of The World & Beyond!
programme.desc: Join Blippi on an adventure to the wonders of our world & beyond! First, he travels to the tallest mountain on Earth, Mt. Everest, with his new friend Betty the Yeti. Then, he dives deep into the ocean to explore a kelp forest with Jerry the Jellyfish. The adventure gets explosive as Blippi & FETCH fly into a volcano! After exploring the Earth, Blippi blasts off into space to tour the solar system, learn about gravity on the moon & discover how rainbows get their amazing colors!

programme.title: E5 - Fun and Games with All Our Friends!
programme.desc: It's time for fun & games with all our friends! First, Jill is shy at her first mermaid swimming class, but she learns to have fun & trust herself with the help of her friends. Then, during a Mexican posada, Manny teaches Baby John how to build a piñata. After he gets over being a little scared of the blindfold, he has lots of fun! The fun continues as the friends learn to compromise when they have opposite ideas for playtime.

programme.title: E7 - JJ's Birthday Celebration
programme.desc: It's the night before JJ's birthday and he is too excited to sleep! Join the fun with a game of musical chairs, a party at the farm with animal friends, and lots of special gifts. Will everything be ready in time for the big day?

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E2 -Meet Farm Animals!
programme.desc: Meet farm animals with Ms. Appleberry and the Melon Patch teachers! Through stories and songs, learn about cows, horses, sheep, and ducks. Discover where they live and what they eat. Learning is full of moos, quacks, and neighs.

programme.title: E4 - Let's Play at Home with the Family!
programme.desc: It's time to play at home with Baby John & the family! First, they get everything ready for a fun movie night in the backyard, complete with popcorn & a projector. Then, the kids make a crazy bubble machine that makes bubbles of all sizes & colors, but it gets a little out of control! The fun at home continues as the kids plan a surprise romantic dinner for Mom & Dad & create a sock puppet show!

programme.title: The Melon Patch S1E8 -Let's Make Music!
programme.desc: Celebrate the joy of music with the Melon Patch teachers! Learn about different instruments, move your body to the beat, and listen to the sounds of nature. Discover how you can use music to express yourself through hands-on, playful fun.

programme.title: E1 - So Many Fun Things to Discover!
programme.desc: There are so many fun things to discover with Mia, Max & their friends! programme.desc: 聚焦18名來自全國一線「主廚」通過不同對戰形式挑戰各類美食命題，加深著觀眾對廚師技能、主廚職業、飲食文化的多重認知。邀請到四位餐飲界頂級大師董振祥、周曉燕、譚綺文、劉一帆，以及代表食客和經營餐飲店的演員袁弘組成評委團，從不同的角度對主廚創作進行品評，見證主廚形象的誕生。

programme.title: E10
programme.desc: 由李晨、吳尊、何超蓮、劉維作常駐嘉賓，帶領觀眾走進阿根廷、新西蘭、泰國、冰島、土耳其、愛爾蘭等國家駐華大使館，探秘各地文化密碼，復刻地道異國風味，並結合中國特色美食文化打造中外融合料理，開啟以食會友、賓至如歸的文化交流真人秀。

programme.title: E1 - 鬆一下 又何妨
programme.desc: 每集精選一篇短篇小說或詩歌散文，由余華、蘇童、陳明昊、魏冰心擔任常駐嘉賓，以溫潤聲線娓娓道來，並邀請學者剖析文本背後的時代印記與人性洞察。

programme.title: E13 - 開啟夏日集訓新章節
programme.desc: 一檔演員搭檔研習進階真人秀，由關錦鵬、吳鎮宇、許鞍華擔當“研習制作人”，參與研習階段任務、監制和拍攝作品，蘇可擔任“研習指導”，陳喬恩、謝娜、李維嘉、吳昕作為“研習助力團”；十多位參與的青年演員，通過共同的生活和訓練，共同開啟尋找搭檔的研習生活。

programme.title: E1 - 鬆一下 又何妨

programme.title: E27
programme.desc: 朱韻剛開始大學生活，就被“壞小子”李峋的闖入徹底顛覆了世界。被朱韻當成不學無術富家子的他，真實身份竟是學校破格錄取的特招生，難得一見的編程天才。兩人在幾次交鋒後，對彼此都有些賞識。學長方志靖對朱韻多次刁難，李峋出手維護朱韻，還邀她加入了自己組建的備賽隊伍，代表學校贏得了重大編程比賽。在相處中，兩人情感日益升溫

programme.title: E31
programme.desc: 故事講述了周筱風（趙又廷 飾）、方筱然（毛曉彤 飾）和林逸（金世佳 飾）三位心臟科醫生機緣巧合下，在東立醫院心臟中心相遇。三人因專業背景、職業理念不同而產生摩擦碰撞，隨後在治病救人的過程中逐漸磨合達成默契，最終在生命戰場並肩作戰的故事。

programme.desc: 朱韻剛開始大學生活，就被“壞小子”李峋的闖入徹底顛覆了世界。被朱韻當成不學無術富家子的他，真實身份竟是學校破格錄取的特招生，難得一見的編程天才。兩人在幾次交鋒後，對彼此都有些賞識。學長方志靖對朱韻多次刁難，李峋出手維護朱韻，還邀她加入了自己組建的備賽隊伍，代表學校贏得了重大編程比賽。在相處中，兩人情感日益升溫

programme.title: My Left Eye Sees Ghosts
programme.desc: May marries Daniel during holiday and inherits all money after his death. One night she suffers a fatal car accident. Ken comes to save her life and strange things happen...

programme.title: The Beloved Son Of God
programme.desc: Fat Cat, a good-natured but mentally retarded adult, is jailed for two years before being bailed out by the Social Welfare Department for good behaviour. Discharges and an orphan, Fat Cat is placed in the custody of a Social Welfare worker Bibi, but there is a communication gap between the two. One day, Bibi takes him to Lantau Island to visit his late parents' grave. As he is crying his heart out, Bibi is involved in a traffic accident, leaving him alone on the Island to lead a wandering life. Seized by cold and hunger at night, Fat Cat tries to steal food from a puppy and is spotted by a stubborn but kind-hearted elder, Granduncle. Failing to find where Fat Cat lives, he takes him home and adopts him. The presence of the simple-minded but optimistic Fat Cat brings much hilarity to the otherwise moribund village. He also wins the elder's favour for resolving the difference between him and his neighbouring youth James, and the three become good friends...

programme.title: Woh Bhi Din The
programme.desc: Rahul Sinha, a famous photojournalist, returns to his alma mater as a guest speaker and takes a nostalgic trip down memory lane to relive his carefree school days and the moment he first fell in love. Release Year: 2024 Director: Sajid Ali

programme.title: Sarkar 3
programme.desc: Gandhi, a real-estate shark, asks for Sarkar's help in a project where residents would lose their homes. However, after Sarkar declines his proposal, he gets involved in several internal conflicts. Release Year: 2017 Director: Ram Gopal Varma

programme.title: Vijay The Master
programme.desc: A professor with a drinking problem goes to a school for young people. He argues with a bad person who makes the students do crimes.

programme.title: Living in the Sky
programme.desc: Naomi works for a small publishing company in the suburbs. After the sudden death of parents, she and her cat move into a towering building arranged by her uncle. But the sense of loss still makes her feel unreal. One day, she meets star actor Morinori...

programme.title: The Fatal Raid
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Inspector Tam Ka Ming, Hei and Special Female Force team Madam, Shirley and a group of commandos started a secret operation to chase a group of gangster across the border of Hong Kong. This led to a large and drawn-out firefight between the police and gangsters, resulting in Shirley and a number of commandos killed in operation. The incident caused Inspector Tam and Madam Fong having a nightmare in these twenty years. Twenty years later, an escort operation bringing Inspector Tam and Madam Fong with four new-generation Special Female Force teammate Alma, Zi Han, Sheila, and Tong Yu to Macau, a group of gangster stormed the operation and they find Hei is still alive...

programme.title: Book of Love
programme.desc: Jiao Ye moved to Macau with her father when she was 15. She is a sassy casino worker who longs for love, but her life was hard. Daniel, a commitment-averse real estate agent in Los Angeles who specializes in selling properties to wealthy Chinese and father of a teenage son. Love blooms between the two as they start exchanging letters because of a book, they sharing their most personal and intimate self with each other.

programme.title: Fantasia
programme.desc: In Hong Kong 1969, private investigation agency boss Man is investigating an extra marital case. With his two employees, the smart looking idiot Kit and the Hong Kong Columbia Radio Night School graduate Pufferfish, he follows the target Lascar Row. The trio stumbles into an antique shop and breaks many antiques in the store. The cheap Man force Kit and Pufferfish to take responsibility. Kit wisely makes Pufferfish take sole responsibility. The dumb Pufferfish helpless buys the pile of shattered antiques with his own money. In the pieces he finds a broken magic lamp...

programme.title: Exclusive Premiere: SANA
programme.desc: You, too, will find yourself humming the melody. It all started with a cassette tape. Sana is a mysterious middle school girl who collects “the sound of soul.” Everyone who hears the melody gets possessed and starts to hum it themselves. At the end of the cursed melody's chain of infections lies an unexpected terror waiting to strike. Just what is Sana after?! Once you hum this melody, it will be your undoing.“Did you get the cassette tape?”

programme.desc: Spanning rivers, canyons, and cities, bridges are symbols of connection and engineering marvels—until they fail catastrophically.
